affected_authority_rules: These ten witnesses validate the new S4.3 authority implementation; they neither add canonical parents nor reopen or inherit S4.2c acceptance.
Use fresh owned S4.3 stores and copies only; never open, modify or fault original historical evidence databases, journals, WAL or SHM files.
One serial test worker; concurrency is only the declared live contenders within each owned case graph.
Real transaction/write/fault/death boundaries and whole-graph closure are required; old-store tests, sequential models and mocked return values give no physical credit.
Unknown commit acknowledgment is not proof of rollback. Retain irreversible usage and uncertainty, and do not resend or restore authority.
Bind exact barriers/APIs, physical positive controls and evidence fields in the affected-gate plan before implementation; fixture/runtime hashes remain required before native execution.

Hashes establish public consistency only, not hostile-host authenticity or permission.

CREATE TABLE store_state (
  singleton INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(singleton)='integer' AND singleton BETWEEN 1 AND 1),
  schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(schema_version)='integer' AND schema_version BETWEEN 1 AND 1),
  store_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(store_id)='text' AND length(store_id)=36 AND substr(store_id,9,1)='-' AND substr(store_id,14,1)='-' AND substr(store_id,19,1)='-' AND substr(store_id,24,1)='-' AND substr(store_id,15,1)='4' AND substr(store_id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b') AND length(replace(store_id,'-',''))=32 AND replace(store_id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  engagement_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(engagement_id)='text' AND length(engagement_id)=36 AND substr(engagement_id,9,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,14,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,19,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,24,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,15,1)='4' AND substr(engagement_id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b') AND length(replace(engagement_id,'-',''))=32 AND replace(engagement_id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  current_revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(current_revision)='integer' AND current_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
  generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(generation)='integer' AND generation BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
  current_owner_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(current_owner_id)='text' AND length(current_owner_id)=36 AND substr(current_owner_id,9,1)='-' AND substr(current_owner_id,14,1)='-' AND substr(current_owner_id,19,1)='-' AND substr(current_owner_id,24,1)='-' AND substr(current_owner_id,15,1)='4' AND substr(current_owner_id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b') AND length(replace(current_owner_id,'-',''))=32 AND replace(current_owner_id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  revoked INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(revoked)='integer' AND revoked BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
  recovery_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(recovery_status)='text' AND recovery_status IN ('ready','recovering','unavailable')),
  last_event_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(last_event_sequence)='integer' AND last_event_sequence BETWEEN 0 AND 2048),
  last_event_sha256 TEXT CHECK (last_event_sha256 IS NULL OR (typeof(last_event_sha256)='text' AND length(last_event_sha256)=64 AND last_event_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  leases_allocated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(leases_allocated)='integer' AND leases_allocated BETWEEN 0 AND 128),
  lease_slots_allocated INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(lease_slots_allocated)='integer' AND lease_slots_allocated BETWEEN 0 AND 1024),
  management_events_used INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(management_events_used)='integer' AND management_events_used BETWEEN 0 AND 1024),
  PRIMARY KEY(singleton),
  UNIQUE(store_id),
  UNIQUE(engagement_id),
  CHECK ((last_event_sequence=0 AND last_event_sha256 IS NULL) OR (last_event_sequence>0 AND last_event_sha256 IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK(lease_slots_allocated=8*leases_allocated),
  FOREIGN KEY (current_revision) REFERENCES roe_revisions (revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  FOREIGN KEY (current_owner_id) REFERENCES owners (owner_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  FOREIGN KEY (last_event_sequence,last_event_sha256) REFERENCES events (sequence,event_sha256) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);

CREATE TABLE roe_revisions (
  revision INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(revision)='integer' AND revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
  engagement_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(engagement_id)='text' AND length(engagement_id)=36 AND substr(engagement_id,9,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,14,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,19,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,24,1)='-' AND substr(engagement_id,15,1)='4' AND substr(engagement_id,20,1) IN ('8','9','a','b') AND length(replace(engagement_id,'-',''))=32 AND replace(engagement_id,'-','') NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  roe_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(roe_sha256)='text' AND length(roe_sha256)=64 AND roe_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
  previous_revision INTEGER CHECK (previous_revision IS NULL OR (typeof(previous_revision)='integer' AND previous_revision BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647)),
  previous_revision_sha256 TEXT CHECK (previous_revision_sha256 IS NULL OR (typeof(previous_revision_sha256)='text' AND length(previous_revision_sha256)=64 AND previous_revision_sha256 NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
  not_before_utc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(not_before_utc)='text' AND length(not_before_utc)=27),
  expires_utc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(expires_utc)='text' AND length(expires_utc)=27),
  actions INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(actions)='integer' AND actions BETWEEN 0 AND 64),
  connections INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(connections)='integer' AND connections BETWEEN 0 AND 64),
  inbound_tls_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(inbound_tls_bytes)='integer' AND inbound_tls_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 1048576),
  outbound_tls_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(outbound_tls_bytes)='integer' AND outbound_tls_bytes BETWEEN 0 AND 524288),
  runtime_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(runtime_ms)='integer' AND runtime_ms BETWEEN 0 AND 320000),
  canonical_record BLOB NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(canonical_record)='blob' AND length(canonical_record) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
  PRIMARY KEY(revision),
  UNIQUE(roe_sha256),
  UNIQUE(revision,roe_sha256),
  CHECK ((revision=1 AND previous_revision IS NULL AND previous_revision_sha256 IS NULL) OR (revision>1 AND previous_revision IS NOT NULL AND previous_revision=revision-1 AND previous_revision_sha256 IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK(not_before_utc<expires_utc),
  FOREIGN KEY (engagement_id) REFERENCES store_state (engagement_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  FOREIGN KEY (previous_revision,previous_revision_sha256) REFERENCES roe_revisions (revision,roe_sha256) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);
